company.shortDescription: AI leader in private markets, turning knowledge into outperformance and alpha.
company.description: ALPHA10X is the AI leader in private markets investing. We enable investors and acquirers to move faster, underwrite with greater conviction, and allocate capital with precision—institutionalizing investment workflows to operationalize decisions that drive confident capital deployment. Founded in 2018, ALPHA10X is headquartered in Dubai with R&D in the South of France. Our team combines deep expertise in AI, quantum knowledge systems, and private-market investing—connecting people, capital, and ideas to reveal the underlying logic of markets. We help investors, acquirers, and strategic advisors turn complexity into clarity and knowledge into alpha. We are builders, operators, and investors who believe performance is driven by insight and strengthened by foresight. Our mission is to equip private-markets capital with intelligence, precision, and conviction.
